basic_profile.bio: An aspiring time traveler and hobbyist electronics enthusiast based in Austin, Texas. Fascinated by the concept of time and space, I spend my free time delving into sci-fi literature and experimenting with DIY electronics kits. I work as a software developer at a local tech startup, which allows me the flexibility to explore my passions. I am currently single and typically online during late evenings after work. I have a penchant for humor and a strong dislike for mundane routines.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in computer science and have taken online courses in electronics. My curiosity about time travel has led me to extensively read scientific theories and sci-fi novels. I'm also a regular attendee of local tech meetups, where I exchange ideas with fellow enthusiasts.
